scenario: 国家名→ISO2 + 占用冲突预检 — '日本'必须转 JP,先 confirm=false 看冲突再决定
input: 新建一个市场叫'日本站',覆盖日本

semantic_rubric: covered country 日本 is sent as its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code JP (upper case), NOT the Chinese name 日本 or the English Japan
market name 日本站 is taken verbatim from the utterance
a country may belong to only one market: sends confirm=false first so an occupied-country conflict is surfaced (the API returns the markets that would be deleted) rather than silently overwriting
does NOT set confirm=true until the user agrees to the reported market deletions
does not fabricate extra countries the user did not name

notes: schema shop.markets.create: name (required, ≤50, unique), countries (required, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 upper), confirm (false default → occupied country rejects with markets-to-delete). ISO conversion + conflict pre-check trap (store-agent market.create).
